newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona cargo traffic up 27.4pct in Feb 97.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona cargo traffic up 27.4pct in Feb 97.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport rose 27.4 percent to 7,930 tonnes in February 1997 compared with the same month in 1996, the airport authority said.

European Union freight business rose 7.7 percent to 3,272 tonnes, while domestic cargo was up 42.8 percent at 3,587 tonnes. Non European Union international freight business rose 58.8 percent and accounted for 1,071 tonnes of the total.

Passenger numbers were up 11.4 percent at 955,356 excluding transit passengers, thanks largely to a 17.7 percent increase in intra European Union passenger traffic to 298,648. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
